description: Check untrusted text (a web page, email, document or tool output) for prompt injection before an agent reads it: instruction overrides, role and chat-template spoofing, data exfiltration links, wallet-drain and key requests, commands, and hidden text (zero-width, Unicode tag smuggling, bidi, HTML comments). Rules plus an LLM judge; returns safe/suspicious/malicious, a 0-100 score, findings with evidence and the text with hidden characters removed. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

model.description: Also ask the LLM judge (default true); false for rules only

text.description: The untrusted text to check, up to 50,000 characters

name: prompt_injection_check
